cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Just us for lunch. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. We learned an audience makes us compete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter just asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. We're already applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out to get a turn.
